recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-31681 across the current build-scoped migration metadata and ModelInfo surfaces; broader full ModelInfo regeneration or unrelated ResearchStudy R5-to-R6 change-map cleanup should be handled under separate Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-31681 was a Published FHIR-core BRR change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking to change the ResearchStudy arm attribute name to comparisonGroup after the work group clarified that arm is not appropriate for all ResearchStudy comparator-group use cases.
initial_application: The active ResearchStudy StructureDefinition already defines ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup with an arm alias/comment and no ResearchStudy.arm element. Git history shows d7dbd7689b50ed517e3900c4512399c2cf62d466 performed the substantive arm-to-comparisonGroup rename in ResearchStudy source, while 9175459a6ea354d82e8b09ca90574344bbe333d6 mentioned #31681 but touched unrelated targetProfile entries.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Later ResearchStudy refactors changed the current comparisonGroup child shape to targetNumber, actualNumber, eligibility, observedGroup, name, and description. The Library resource and its FHIR ModelInfo example are active build-scoped source through source/fhir.ini, list-Library-examples.xml, library-examples-header.xml, and publish.ini. Direct community searches found no FHIR-31681 references, and broader BRR minutes reaffirmed that comparisonGroup was chosen instead of arm to support observational research.
reconciliation: Updated source/fhir.ini so the R4-to-R6 change metadata maps ResearchStudy.arm, arm.name, and arm.description to current comparisonGroup paths while leaving arm.type as deleted because current R6 has no comparisonGroup.type. Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to expose ResearchStudy.comparisonGroup and ResearchStudy.ComparisonGroup using the current child shape, and refreshed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so the embedded Library payload matches the readable ModelInfo content.
